notes.title: Changes to the release plans & March 25 Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, some pretty important news for you today, so make sure to read the entire post!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/752c33338069b18ee18987f230058d95ffc3afb2.png

First of all, let's get the big news out of the way - Tune in to the show will be split into two parts. With the release of Episode 9 in May, the first half of the story will be marked as complete, and the 2nd half of the story will be covered in Tune in to the show Part 2, which is going to be a separate game. This wasn't the original plan, and I didn't want to split the game into seasons like most other developers do, but it's become clear that it's the only feasible way to go about it financially. The situation is quite simple - if I don't release Part 2 as a separate game, I'll most likely run out of money before the game can be completed. My other project, An Evening of Wonders, turned out to be a complete flop, and I'd rather focus on Tune in to the show than gamble on another side project doing better to fund the development. I know this isn't great news, but it is what it is, and I hope you can understand my perspective.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/84b34861b6e336160c27805209c6b5f2cd0cf570.png

So, how is it going to work? When Episode 9 releases in May, this game will be marked as complete. The future episodes will be a part of Tune in to the show Part 2, which is going to be a separate game on Steam. You'll be able to import your saves from Part 1 or just choose which girls you're romancing with a short quiz if you don't want to import saves. I'll create a store page for Part 2 soon so that you can add it to your wishlists before Part 1 is finished. I think that Part 2 will also be released in Early Access this year, once Episode 10 is ready (and it's going to be bigger than usual Episodes to start strong).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/f35603d0774ff3ad3bdc8abed3668aaefa23b84a.png

Now, onto the usual stuff - I'm currently working on Episode 9, and it's going pretty well so far. A lot of the writing is done already, and it seems that this update will be one of the longest ones yet. The renders are coming along nicely too, and I'll start working on the first animations soon. If you're interested in Diana, you'll also end up meeting her older sister in this update. She can be seen in the render below :) The release date is set to May, and I don't anticipate any issues meeting it since everything's going smoothly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/b3c22c289c348a1b04d69eaba1bffeee8b800d00.png

That's all for this post. I hope you're all doing well, and I'll see you in the next development update. Thank you for playing the game, reading, and your understanding,

RobertDeadth

notes.title: Episode 8 Update & Plans For 2024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I wanted to give you all a quick update on my plans for Episode 8 and the rest of the year overall!

If you follow me on Patreon, where I've been posting free weekly development updates every week for almost 3 years, you probably know all of this already, but I realise that most people probably only use one of the platforms (Steam/Patreon) to keep up with the news, so I wanted everyone to be up-to-date.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/31cd2be33777ccefcab7eeee2e72d658c6763c53.png

Let me first get the bad news out of the way: Episode 8 will be released in December, not September/October as the usual schedule would suggest. After Episode 7 was released, I decided to take a bit of time off this project and focus on finishing my small upcoming game, An Evening of Wonders. I realise this might upset some of you, but in the end, I felt it was necessary. There are many Episodes of Tune in to the show left before the game is completed, and releasing a different project should help me a lot when it comes to financial stability. That is, assuming An Evening of Wonders does at least fairly well. If it flops, well, at least I tried and took the risk.

In any case, my plans for the rest of the year are as follows:


 November: An Evening of Wonders Steam release
 December: Episode 8 of Tune in to the show Steam release.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/b21be2827c5c6a13c4831232650ebd49b3fc8a55.png

I wasn't fully happy with how Episode 7 turned out, so I'll be doing my best to make Episode 8 a good one. I'll start working on it as soon as I'm done with An Evening of Wonders (should be the end of September.)

Anyway, I'm sorry for the delay and thank you for your understanding. You can expect the usual development update posts with new preview renders of Episode 8 to come back in October.

That's all for this time, thank you for reading and playing the game, I hope you're all doing well,

RobertDeadth

notes.title: Bugfix to Episode 5 Part 2
notes.notes:

You can skip to the scene you missed quickly by holding the left Ctrl button on your keyboard. The error shouldn't happen now and you should be able to see the scene with Ayaka. I'm sorry for the trouble and thank you for your understanding,

notes.title: The official release date and a short progress report!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/a4d7cd0ea38f6023be5a9233df5fd3e01f37dd0f.png

Apart from that, I've been working hard on creating more animations for the game. When the game is released, it'll feature 20 animations, most of them in the game's spicy scenes.

Overall, things are going really well and I'm excited for the game's release. The work that's still left to be done is mostly testing and making some small corrections and improvements.

Thank you for your interest and reading, hope you're all doing well, see you next time,
